name: Spanish Common Words Set 28
description: This is part of a larger set of common Spanish words.

cards.sentence: Nosotras somos el equipo campeón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are the champion team.

cards.sentence: Vosotras siempre tenéis las mejores ideas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You all always have the best ideas.

cards.irregularForms: estoy, estás, está, estamos, estáis, están
cards.sentence: Quiero estar contigo en la playa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to be with you on the beach.

cards.sentence: No hay ningún problema con eso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There is no problem with that.

cards.sentence: Leí toda la noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I read all night.

cards.sentence: Tenemos algunas preguntas para usted.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have some questions for you.

cards.sentence: Este libro es mío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This book is mine.

cards.sentence: Esa idea es mía.
cards.sentenceTranslation: That idea is mine.

cards.sentence: Estos zapatos son míos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: These shoes are mine.

cards.sentence: Estas llaves son mías.
cards.sentenceTranslation: These keys are mine.

cards.sentence: El problema es tuyo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The problem is yours.

cards.sentence: La decisión es tuya.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The decision is yours.

cards.sentence: Esos perros son tuyos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Those dogs are yours.

cards.sentence: Esas flores son tuyas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Those flowers are yours.

cards.sentence: Estas son nuestras casas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: These are our houses.

cards.sentence: Vuestras intenciones son buenas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Your intentions are good.

cards.sentence: Mis padres están de vacaciones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My parents are on vacation.

cards.sentence: Quiero ver tus nuevos dibujos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to see your new drawings.

cards.sentence: Hay demasiadas cosas que hacer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are too many things to do.

cards.sentence: Tenemos bastantes manzanas para todos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have enough apples for everyone.

cards.sentence: Compró varias camisetas nuevas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She bought several new T-shirts.

cards.sentence: Hay ciertas reglas que debemos seguir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are certain rules we must follow.

cards.sentence: Ambas opciones son válidas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Both options are valid.

cards.sentence: Estaban solos en la casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They were alone in the house.

cards.sentence: Las chicas estaban solas en el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The girls were alone in the park.

cards.sentence: Los primeros resultados fueron prometedores.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The first results were promising.

cards.sentence: Las primeras flores del jardín ya abrieron.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The first flowers in the garden have already opened.

cards.sentence: Las últimas noticias fueron muy tristes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The latest news was very sad.

cards.sentence: Por favor, lean las siguientes instrucciones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Please read the following instructions.

cards.sentence: Sus trabajos anteriores eran muy buenos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His previous jobs were very good.

cards.sentence: Sus calificaciones son superiores a la media.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His grades are above average.

cards.sentence: Los precios de los productos inferiores bajaron.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The prices of inferior products went down.

cards.sentence: Quiero encontrar las mejores opciones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to find the best options.

cards.sentence: Esos fueron los peores días de mi vida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Those were the worst days of my life.

cards.sentence: Mis hermanos mayores me cuidan.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My older brothers take care of me.

cards.sentence: Los niños menores de cinco años entran gratis.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Children under five years old enter for free.

cards.sentence: Los gatos blancos son muy elegantes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: White cats are very elegant.

cards.sentence: Mis botas negras combinan con todo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My black boots go with everything.

cards.sentence: Las manzanas rojas son mis favoritas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Red apples are my favorite.

cards.sentence: El cielo y el mar son azules.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sky and the sea are blue.

cards.sentence: Las hojas de los árboles son verdes en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Tree leaves are green in summer.

cards.sentence: Los taxis en Nueva York suelen ser amarillos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Taxis in New York are usually yellow.

cards.sentence: Las nubes grises anuncian lluvia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Grey clouds announce rain.

cards.sentence: Los ojos marrones son comunes en mi familia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Brown eyes are common in my family.

cards.sentence: Tienen unos cachorros muy lindos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They have some very cute puppies.

cards.sentence: Qué flores tan lindas trajiste.
cards.sentenceTranslation: What pretty flowers you brought.

cards.sentence: Algunos edificios antiguos son feos para mí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Some old buildings are ugly to me.

cards.sentence: No me gustan las excusas feas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I don't like ugly excuses.

cards.sentence: Estos paisajes son muy bonitos en otoño.
cards.sentenceTranslation: These landscapes are very beautiful in autumn.

cards.sentence: Sus fotografías son muy bonitas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Her photographs are very beautiful.

cards.sentence: Después de correr, estábamos muy cansadas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: After running, we were very tired.

cards.sentence: Mi hermana está enferma hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My sister is sick today.

cards.sentence: Muchos pacientes estaban enfermos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Many patients were sick.

cards.sentence: Las mujeres enfermas necesitan descanso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sick women need rest.

cards.sentence: Las puertas estaban abiertas de par en par.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The doors were wide open.

cards.sentence: Las tiendas estarán cerradas el domingo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The stores will be closed on Sunday.

cards.sentence: Me encantan las bebidas calientes en invierno.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love hot drinks in winter.

cards.sentence: Los días fríos me hacen querer café.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Cold days make me want coffee.

cards.sentence: Las noches frías de invierno son largas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Cold winter nights are long.

cards.sentence: Las cajas estaban llenas de juguetes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The boxes were full of toys.

cards.sentence: Las botellas estaban vacías.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bottles were empty.

cards.sentence: Hay decisiones importantes que tomar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are important decisions to make.

cards.sentence: Sus historias siempre son muy interesantes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His stories are always very interesting.

cards.sentence: Las reuniones largas son aburridas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Long meetings are boring.

cards.sentence: Les deseo buenas noches a todos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I wish you all a good night.

cards.sentence: Las noticias malas llegaron pronto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bad news arrived soon.

cards.sentence: Las casas pequeñas son acogedoras.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Small houses are cozy.

cards.sentence: Las montañas altas son impresionantes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Tall mountains are impressive.

cards.sentence: Las temperaturas bajas afectan la cosecha.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Low temperatures affect the harvest.

cards.sentence: Tenemos ideas nuevas para el proyecto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have new ideas for the project.

cards.sentence: Las viejas fotos me traen recuerdos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Old photos bring me memories.

cards.sentence: Estas galletas están muy ricas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: These cookies are very tasty.

cards.sentence: Las familias pobres necesitan ayuda.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Poor families need help.

cards.sentence: Las habitaciones estaban limpias y ordenadas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The rooms were clean and tidy.

cards.sentence: Las calles sucias necesitan ser barridas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The dirty streets need to be swept.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos manos fuertes para mover esto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need strong hands to move this.

cards.sentence: Las luces débiles no iluminaban mucho.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The dim lights didn't illuminate much.

cards.sentence: Las respuestas rápidas son importantes en el examen.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Fast answers are important on the exam.

cards.sentence: Las tortugas son criaturas muy lentas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Turtles are very slow creatures.

cards.sentence: Sus explicaciones fueron muy claras.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Her explanations were very clear.

cards.sentence: Me gustan las películas de temas oscuras.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like movies with dark themes.

cards.sentence: Las tiendas más cercanas están a dos cuadras.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The closest stores are two blocks away.

cards.sentence: Las galaxias lejanas son difíciles de observar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Distant galaxies are difficult to observe.

cards.sentence: Estuve estudiando hasta tarde anoche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I was studying late last night.

cards.sentence: Voy al cine a menudo con mis amigos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I often go to the cinema with my friends.

cards.sentence: Quizás mañana haga sol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Perhaps it will be sunny tomorrow.

cards.sentence: Sólo quiero un café, por favor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I only want a coffee, please.

cards.sentence: Se presentó ante el juez.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He appeared before the judge.

cards.sentence: Habla más despacio, por favor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Speak more slowly, please.

cards.sentence: De repente, empezó a llover muy fuerte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Suddenly, it started raining very heavily.

cards.sentence: Es sin duda la mejor película del año.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is undoubtedly the best movie of the year.

cards.sentence: Por fin llegaron las vacaciones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Finally, the holidays arrived.

cards.sentence: ¿De verdad quieres irte tan temprano?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Do you really want to leave so early?

cards.sentence: Tenemos que empezar de nuevo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have to start again.

cards.sentence: A propósito, ¿ya terminaste el informe?
cards.sentenceTranslation: By the way, have you finished the report yet?

cards.sentence: ¿Estás hablando en serio o es una broma?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Are you serious or is it a joke?

cards.sentence: Lo encontré por casualidad en la calle.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I found him by chance in the street.

cards.sentence: En general, me gusta la gente amable.
cards.sentenceTranslation: In general, I like kind people.

cards.sentence: Su canto alegraba la mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Its song brightened the morning.

cards.sentence: A los niños les encantan los dulces.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Children love sweets.

cards.sentence: ¿Cuáles son tus planes para el fin de semana?
cards.sentenceTranslation: What are your plans for the weekend?

cards.sentence: ¿Qué dices de ir al cine?
cards.sentenceTranslation: What do you say about going to the cinema?

cards.sentence: ¿Qué haces en tu tiempo libre?
cards.sentenceTranslation: What do you do in your free time?

cards.sentence: ¿Adónde vas tan rápido?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Where are you going so fast?

cards.sentence: ¿Dónde vives ahora?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Where do you live now?

cards.sentence: ¿Qué comes cuando tienes hambre?
cards.sentenceTranslation: What do you eat when you are hungry?

cards.sentence: ¿Qué bebes para hidratarte?
cards.sentenceTranslation: What do you drink to hydrate yourself?

cards.sentence: ¿Sabes la respuesta a esta pregunta?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Do you know the answer to this question?

cards.sentence: Si quieres, puedes venir con nosotros.
cards.wordTranslation: you can, you are able to
cards.sentenceTranslation: If you want, you can come with us.

cards.sentence: ¿Qué quieres de regalo de cumpleaños?
cards.sentenceTranslation: What do you want for a birthday present?

cards.sentence: Mi amigo viene a visitarme hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My friend is coming to visit me today.

cards.sentence: Veo la televisión por las noches.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I watch television at night.

cards.sentence: Te doy las gracias por tu ayuda.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I thank you for your help.

cards.sentence: Me pongo el abrigo porque hace frío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I put on my coat because it's cold.

cards.sentence: Salgo de casa a las ocho en punto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I leave home at eight o'clock sharp.
